query:
INSERT INTO GAMES (
                    room_id,
                    players,
                    state,
                    moves,
                    winner,
                    is_completed
                )
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                RETURNING 
                    id,
                    room_id,
                    players as "players!: Json<Vec<Player>>",
                    state as "state!: Json<Vec<Vec<Option<MoveType>>>>",
                    moves as "moves!: Json<Vec<Move>>",
                    winner,
                    is_completed,
                    created_at,
                    completed_at
